sentences.en: The Representative said he will put a brake on spending.
sentences.zh: 代表说他将对开支进行控制。

sentences.en: An aging population will require more spending on health care.
sentences.zh: 老龄化人口需要在医疗保健方面投入更多资金。

sentences.en: By September the burst in spending seemed to be tapering off.
sentences.zh: 到九月，开支激增似乎开始减缓。

senses.zh: 花费；度过（spend的现在分词形式）
